REMARKS:
251500Z POSITION NEAR 13.0N 164.3E.
25OCT26. TYPHOON 30W (IN-FA), LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 314 NM
NORTHWEST OF KWAJALEIN, HAS TRACKED NORTH-NORTHWESTWARD AT 09
KNOTS OVER THE PAST SIX HOURS.
MINIMUM CENTRAL PRESSURE AT 251200Z IS 979 MB. MAXIMUM
SIGNIFICANT WAVE HEIGHT AT 251200Z IS 25 FEET. NEXT WARNINGS AT
252100Z, 260300Z, 260900Z AND 261500Z.
REFER TO TROPICAL STORM 29W (CHAMPI) WARNINGS (WTPN32 PGTW)
FOR SIX-HOURLY UPDATES.//
